# WO-106: Exposure card: hide a zero manual-check line and cap long explanations (CP-06)
Status: open
Vendor: codex
Agent: app-ui
Owner contact: Morgan Reyes (channel)
Assigned to: Codex channel session
Source: docs/vendor/CODEX_PROPOSALS.md CP-06 (accepted; owner decisions below)

## Goal
Follow-ups to WO-005 (PR #10, merged) on the Today page's exposure card, `exposure_card()` in src/freemyid/wizard/views.py.

## Owner decisions (fixed, don't change the wording)
- Manual-check line: hide it entirely when the count is 0. Keep "1 site needs a manual check." / "N sites need a manual check." for 1 and more.
- Explanations: show at most 5 lines. If there are more, show the first 5 in their existing order, then one final line exactly: "…and N more reasons" (N = the number hidden; use "…and 1 more reason" when N is 1). Use the real ellipsis character.

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
- New tests with fake, deterministic results cover: manual count 0 (line absent), 1 (singular), 3 (plural); 5 explanations (no overflow line), 6 (one more reason), 9 (four more reasons).
- Everything else is unchanged: score, coverage context, checked date, HTML escaping of every explanation, and the difference between "data unavailable" and "zero found".
- Existing exposure-card and wizard tests still pass; `ruff check src tests` clean.

## Allowed paths (the vendor may change ONLY these)
- src/freemyid/wizard/views.py (only `exposure_card` and helpers used only by it)
- tests/test_wizard_exposure_card_followups.py (new)
- VENDOR_STATUS.md

## Out of scope / do not touch
Exposure engine, exposure_models.py, storage, consent, security code, CSS/templates outside views.py, and every other function in views.py. In-house SEC-93a (labelling the card per person) also touches exposure_card: it is held until WO-106 merges, so don't attempt it.

## Test commands
`.venv/bin/pytest -q tests/test_wizard_exposure_card_followups.py tests/ -k "exposure or wizard"` then `.venv/bin/ruff check src tests` (use the main checkout's .venv by absolute path).

## Check-in plan
Report in docs/vendor/CODEX_TO_CLAUDE.md when done.
